info.description: Triggers for STUB-SWIFTGW via POST /api/run/event. Config lives in collection variables (cfg*). Fresh IDs are generated per run by the collection pre-request script. Run T21 and T22 immediately after T01.

exec: // Collection pre-request: snapshot previous run, reset to central config, generate fresh IDs
